svg.title: txgrx — terminal hacker profile
svg.desc: Fallout-style CRT terminal displaying txgrx's profile: CS student, cybersecurity, data science, AI interests

g.text: I spend my time where systems meet their limits —
and occasionally break things on purpose to understand them better.
Currently learning something new every single day,
and that's not going to stop anytime soon.
"There are only two hard things in Computer Science:
> The list grows. Come back in a few months.
